title: Asset & Operations Intelligence
summary: Predictive maintenance, reliability, and precision/quality — keeping physical assets and operations running at their best.

solutions.title: Predictive maintenance
solutions.body: Failure prediction before breakdown, using sensor and maintenance-history data to flag at-risk assets ahead of time.

solutions.title: Reliability analytics for high-value assets
solutions.body: Warranty reserve and failure modeling for large, long-lifecycle assets.

solutions.title: Precision & quality
solutions.body: Computer-vision defect detection integrated into production lines.

title: Supply Chain & Demand Intelligence
summary: Forecasting and inventory optimization so the right stock is in the right place at the right time.

solutions.title: Demand forecasting
solutions.body: SKU- and segment-level forecasting that blends macro, seasonal, and promotional signals.

solutions.title: Inventory optimization
solutions.body: EOQ and safety-stock modeling to cut carrying cost without hurting service levels.

title: Cost, Process & Efficiency
summary: Six Sigma–driven yield and waste reduction across manufacturing and back-office processes.

solutions.title: Yield & waste reduction
solutions.body: Statistical process control and root-cause analysis to lift first-pass yield.

solutions.title: Process cost modeling
solutions.body: Activity-based costing to find where cost-to-serve is highest and why.

title: Risk, Compliance & ESG
summary: Credit scoring, fraud detection, and CBAM/export-compliance analytics for regulated and high-exposure businesses.

solutions.title: Creditworthiness scoring
solutions.body: Multi-variable scoring models built on a CRISP-DM methodology.

solutions.title: Fraud detection
solutions.body: Anomaly-detection models tuned to transaction- or claims-level data.

solutions.title: CBAM / export compliance analytics
solutions.body: Emissions and trade-compliance reporting support for exporters facing new carbon-border rules.

title: Growth & Commercial Analytics
summary: Marketing budget impact and customer/segment analytics to grow revenue with evidence, not guesswork.

solutions.title: Marketing budget impact assessment
solutions.body: Media-mix and attribution modeling to show which spend actually moves revenue.

solutions.title: Customer & segment analytics
solutions.body: Behavioral segmentation and lifetime-value modeling to prioritize the customers worth investing in.

title: Digital Transformation & AI Platforms
summary: GenAI, BI dashboards, and AI-optimized hardware — the platforms that make the other pillars run at scale.

solutions.title: GenAI deployment
solutions.body: Applied GenAI for internal knowledge work and customer-facing use cases.

solutions.title: BI dashboards & analytics platforms
solutions.body: End-to-end visual analytics platforms built for a specific decision workflow, not a generic BI tool.

solutions.title: AI-optimized hardware
solutions.body: GPU and edge-hardware power-performance optimization for AI workloads.

title: Capability Building & Training
summary: Executive and technical training programs — a different buyer and budget line from the other six pillars, so it stays its own front door.

solutions.title: Executive AI & analytics programs
solutions.body: Leadership-level programs on AI strategy and data-driven decision-making.

solutions.title: Technical upskilling programs
solutions.body: Hands-on training in Business Analytics, Machine Learning, and RPA for practitioner teams.
